本实用新型公开了一种生物基因提取仪器，包括柜体结构的工作台，在所述工作台上对应设有离心机、震荡器、沸水浴单元，在所述离心机、震荡器及沸水浴单元内对应设有多个反应管，在所述工作台的侧边对应设有六轴机器人，所述六轴机器人的末端机械手与提取治具对应连接。本实用新型一种生物基因提取仪器结构简单，集成化、运行自动化程度高，可有效的提高对生物基因提取作业的灵活性、便捷性和工作效率，尤其适合数量较多样品的，比如血液中病毒的基因提取。

Biological gene extraction instrumentTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of biological gene extraction equipment in the serum and specifically relates to a biological gene extraction instrument.

Background

The biological gene extraction instrument is mainly used for extracting genes of organisms or plants, and separation and purification work related to biomolecules is very important and indispensable in almost every laboratory. However, it is still quite difficult to purify the sample efficiently, and not only a proper purification technology needs to be selected, but also the workload is extremely large, and the requirement of extracting and purifying the high-throughput sample by the current rapid development is difficult to meet. Hepatitis b (hereinafter, hepatitis b) is an infectious disease caused by Hepatitis B Virus (HBV), mainly with hepatitis virus infection and causing multiple organ damage. At present, about 9300 million HBV carriers (hepatitis B surface antigen carriers) and 3000 million hepatitis B patients exist in China, and the HBV carrier is an infectious disease which is most popular and most harmful currently in China. Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) is one of the most important factors that endanger the safety of blood transfusion. The HBV gene detection can greatly shorten the detection window period, provides guarantee for blood transfusion safety, and the quick and effective gene extraction method can lay a good foundation for subsequent detection work. The traditional biological gene method is to manually operate each step, has low automation degree and high labor cost in the operation process, and can seriously influence the promotion of subsequent work when blood samples are more, so a biological gene extraction instrument needs to be provided.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Aiming at the defects of the prior art, the biological gene extraction instrument is provided.

The utility model discloses a following scheme realizes:

a biological gene extraction instrument comprises a workbench with a cabinet body structure, wherein a centrifugal machine, an oscillator and a boiling water bath unit are correspondingly arranged on the workbench, a plurality of reaction tubes are correspondingly arranged in the centrifugal machine, the oscillator and the boiling water bath unit, six robots are correspondingly arranged on the side edges of the workbench, and the tail end manipulators of the six robots are correspondingly connected with an extraction jig;

the extraction jig comprises a horizontal fixing plate, and a clamping mechanism and a liquid transfer mechanism are correspondingly arranged on the horizontal fixing plate; the liquid transfer mechanism comprises a vertical fixed plate arranged at the free end of a horizontal fixed plate, the vertical fixed plate is correspondingly connected with a vertical moving plate, a vertical moving motor is correspondingly arranged on the vertical moving plate, the vertical moving motor drives the vertical moving plate to vertically move on the vertical fixed plate, the lower end of the vertical moving plate is correspondingly connected with the horizontal moving plate, two horizontal moving motors are correspondingly arranged on the horizontal moving plate, the two horizontal moving motors respectively drive a horizontal moving slide block to correspondingly horizontally move on the horizontal moving plate, and a clamping block is correspondingly arranged at the bottom of each horizontal moving slide block;

the liquid transfer mechanism comprises a horizontal fixing plate, a plurality of liquid transfer pipes and a plurality of reagent storage containers, the liquid transfer pipes are arranged on the horizontal fixing plate, the reagent storage containers are arranged on the upper end of the horizontal fixing plate, the reagent storage containers and the reagent storage containers are arranged on the lower end of the horizontal fixing plate, the reagent storage containers and the reagent storage containers are correspondingly arranged at the upper end of the horizontal fixing plate, the reagent storage containers and the reagent storage containers are correspondingly arranged on the lower end of the horizontal fixing plate, the reagent storage containers and the reagent storage containers are correspondingly communicated, and the reagent storage containers are.

The bottom of the workbench is correspondingly provided with a plurality of telescopic supporting legs, and the bottom of the workbench is also correspondingly provided with a plurality of universal wheels.

The clamping block is of an inverted T-shaped structure.

The centrifugal machine is correspondingly provided with a centrifugal groove which is centrosymmetric and is matched with the reaction tube.

The boiling water bath unit comprises a plurality of boiling water baths.

A plurality of oscillating holes are arranged in the oscillator.

Still include the reaction tube circulation unit of keeping in, the reaction tube circulation unit of keeping in includes an annular slide rail of keeping in there are a plurality of temporary storage sliders on the slide rail of keeping in all correspond on every temporary storage slider and are equipped with the reaction tube and keep in the groove.

The utility model has the advantages that:

the utility model relates to a biological gene draws instrument simple structure integrates, the operation degree of automation is high, can effectual improvement to flexibility, convenience and the work efficiency of biological gene extraction operation, especially be fit for the more sample of a quantity, for example the gene of virus draws in the blood.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic view of a biological gene extraction apparatus according to the present invention;

FIG. 2 is a detailed view of the structure of portion A in FIG. 1;

FIG. 3 is a plan view of a worktable of the biological gene extracting apparatus of the present invention.

In the figure: the device comprises a worktable 1, a supporting leg 2, a universal wheel 3, a centrifuge 4, a centrifugal tank 41, an oscillator 5, an oscillation hole 51, a boiling water bath unit 6, a boiling water bath 61, a six-axis robot 7, an extraction jig 8, a filling head 81, a supernatant liquid suction head 82, a solution filling pipe 83, a reagent storage container 84, a filling dosing pump 85, a solution recovery pipe 86, a solution recovery storage container 87, a solution recovery dosing pump 88, a horizontal fixing plate 89, a vertical fixing plate 810, a vertical moving plate 811, a vertical moving motor 813, a horizontal moving plate 814, a horizontal moving motor 815, a horizontal moving sliding block 816, a clamping block 9, a reaction tube 10, a reaction tube circulation temporary storage unit 101, a reaction tube temporary storage tank 102, a temporary storage sliding block 103 and a temporary storage sliding rail.

Detailed Description

The preferred embodiments of the present invention will be further described with reference to the accompanying drawings in which:

as shown in FIGS. 1 and 3, a biological gene extraction instrument comprises a workbench 1 of a cabinet body structure, wherein a centrifuge 4, an oscillator 5 and a boiling water bath unit 6 are correspondingly arranged on the workbench 1, a plurality of reaction tubes 9 are correspondingly arranged in the centrifuge 4, the oscillator 5 and the boiling water bath unit 6, in the embodiment, the upper parts of the reaction tubes are in a square frame-shaped structure, so that clamping blocks can be conveniently clamped, and the specific structure of the reaction tubes is not repeated.

A six-axis robot 7 is correspondingly arranged on the side edge of the workbench 1, and a tail end manipulator of the six-axis robot 7 is correspondingly connected with an extraction jig 8;

as shown in fig. 2, the extracting fixture 8 includes a horizontal fixing plate 89, and a gripping mechanism and a liquid-transferring mechanism are correspondingly disposed on the horizontal fixing plate 89; the liquid transfer mechanism comprises a vertical fixing plate 810 arranged at the free end of a horizontal fixing plate 89, the vertical fixing plate 810 is correspondingly connected with a vertical moving plate 811, a vertical moving motor 812 is correspondingly arranged on the vertical moving plate 811, the vertical moving motor 812 drives the vertical moving plate 811 to vertically move on the vertical fixing plate 810, the lower end of the vertical moving plate 811 is correspondingly connected with a horizontal moving plate 813, two horizontal moving motors 814 are correspondingly arranged on the horizontal moving plate 813, the two horizontal moving motors 814 respectively drive a horizontal moving slider 815 to horizontally move on the horizontal moving plate 813, and a clamping block 816 is correspondingly arranged at the bottom of each horizontal moving slider 815; the clamping block 816 is an inverted "T" shaped structure, which facilitates clamping the reaction tube.

The liquid transfer mechanism comprises a plurality of solution filling heads 81 and a plurality of supernatant liquid suction heads 82 which are arranged at the lower end of a horizontal fixing plate 89, each solution filling head 81 is correspondingly communicated with a corresponding solution filling pipe 83, each solution filling pipe 83 is correspondingly communicated with a corresponding reagent storage container 84, a filling quantitative pump 85 is correspondingly arranged on each solution filling pipe 83, each supernatant liquid suction head 82 is correspondingly communicated with a corresponding solution recovery pipe 86, the solution recovery pipe 86 is correspondingly communicated with a recovered solution storage container 87, a solution recovery quantitative pump 88 is correspondingly arranged on the solution recovery pipe 86, and the reagent storage container 84 and the recovered solution storage container 87 are correspondingly arranged at the upper end of the horizontal fixing plate 89.

The filling quantitative pump and the solution recovery quantitative pump can adopt diaphragm pumps, and can be selected and purchased on the market according to specific process parameters, and the specific working principle, the internal structure and the working process are known technologies and are not described in detail herein.

The quantitative pump is used for receiving the control signal of a regulator or a computer in the control process, changing the flow rate of the regulated medium and maintaining the regulated parameters in the required range, thereby achieving the automation of the production process.

In an embodiment, a vertical sliding rail (not shown in the drawings) is provided in the vertical fixing plate, and a vertical moving motor driving roller (not shown in the drawings) correspondingly connected to the vertical moving plate performs vertical movement on the vertical sliding rail. And a penetrating square groove type slide rail is correspondingly arranged on the horizontal moving plate, a horizontal moving motor drives a horizontal moving slide block to slide on the square groove type slide rail, and the lower end of the horizontal moving slide block penetrates through the horizontal moving plate and is correspondingly connected with the clamping head.

The bottom of the workbench 1 is correspondingly provided with a plurality of telescopic supporting legs 2, and the bottom of the workbench 1 is also correspondingly provided with a plurality of universal wheels 3. The universal wheel and the telescopic landing leg are matched for use, and the daily use and the integral movement of the equipment can be facilitated.

The centrifuge 4 is correspondingly provided with 12 centrifugal grooves 41, the 12 centrifugal grooves 41 are centrosymmetric, and the centrifugal grooves 41 are matched with the reaction tube 9. The specific number of the centrifugal grooves for placing the reaction tubes in the centrifuge corresponds to the oscillator and the boiling water bath unit, and the specific working principle, the internal structure and the working process of the centrifuge are known technologies and are not described in detail herein.

The boiling water bath unit 6 includes a plurality of boiling water baths 61. A plurality of reaction tubes may be placed in each of the boiling water baths 61 to be heated. The utility model provides a water bath that boils adopts the stainless steel inner bag, at the bottom installation heater and the excessive temperature probe in the water bath that boils, the heater is in the stainless steel inner bag, by the protection of poroid flat dish, and the heat directly passes to aquatic, guarantees rapid heating up. The specific working principle, internal structure and working process of the boiling water bath are well known technologies and are not described in detail herein.

A plurality of oscillation holes 51 are provided in the oscillator 5. The oscillator is driven by the motor to rotate the cam to generate oscillation, so as to uniformly mix the solution in the reaction tube 9, and the specific working principle, the internal structure and the working process of the oscillator are known technologies and are not described herein again.

Still include reaction tube circulation temporary storage unit 10, reaction tube circulation temporary storage unit 10 includes an annular slide rail 103 of keeping in there are a plurality of temporary storage sliders 102 on the slide rail 103 of keeping in all correspond on every slide 102 of keeping in and be equipped with reaction tube temporary storage groove 101.

The working process of the application is briefly described as follows: the DNA concentrated solution and the DNA extracting solution are respectively stored in a plurality of reagent storage containers in advance, and specific chemical components and concentrations of the DNA concentrated solution and the DNA extracting solution can be purchased or prepared according to actual conditions, so that the method is a known technology and is not described herein again.

When the device starts to work, all the reaction tubes are positioned in the oscillator, in the embodiment, 18 reaction tubes are arranged in the oscillator, firstly, a serum sample and DNA concentrated solution of genes to be extracted are added into each reaction tube manually, and a blood sample can be replaced by a blank sample, a reference sample and a quality control sample, so that the yield of the extraction process can be objectively evaluated. In this embodiment, first, 100 ml of serum sample is manually added into each reaction tube, then the six-axis robot controls the extraction jig to move to the upper side of the corresponding reaction tube, 100 ml of DNA concentrated solution is added into the reaction tube by controlling the corresponding filling dosing pump, the oscillator is started to oscillate and mix uniformly, at this time, the two horizontal moving motors respectively drive the corresponding horizontal moving slide blocks to move in opposite directions, the distance between the two clamping blocks is increased, then the six-axis robot controls the extraction jig to move to the right above the oscillating and mixing reaction tube, the vertical moving motor performs vertical fine adjustment on the vertical moving plate to drive the two clamping blocks to perform fine adjustment on the vertical position, when the two clamping blocks are located at the two sides of the upper part of the reaction tube, the two horizontal moving motors respectively drive the corresponding horizontal moving slide blocks to move in opposite directions, the distance between two clamp splices diminishes, until two clamp splices will correspond the reaction tube clip, six robot control this moment draw the tool and move to centrifuge's centrifugation inslot, 5 minutes of centrifugation under 12000 revolutions per minute's rotational speed, then draw the tool by six robot control and move to the top of corresponding reaction tube, through controlling corresponding solution recovery dosing pump, draw the supernatant to retrieve the solution and deposit the container (the volume of drawing of supernatant can realize setting for according to empirical value, in this embodiment, draw 120 ml supernatant, the supernatant is deposited in retrieving the solution and depositing the container, regular unified processing). After the initial centrifugation and the supernatant fluid absorption, the six-axis robot controls the extraction jig to move into the oscillator again, then, another filling quantitative pump is used to fill the DNA extracting solution stored in another reagent storage container into the corresponding reaction tube, in this embodiment, 30 ml of DNA extracting solution is added into the reaction tube, the oscillator is started again to oscillate and mix uniformly, the reaction tube after oscillating and mixing uniformly is moved into a 100 ℃ boiling water bath unit for heat preservation for 10 minutes as the above steps are similar, the reaction tube with heat preservation for 10 minutes at 100 ℃ is moved into a centrifugal groove of the centrifugal machine, centrifugation is carried out for 5 minutes at a rotating speed of 12000 r/min, the supernatant fluid after the centrifugation is the biological gene extracting solution with higher gene concentration, and the biological gene extracting solution can be directly moved to the next procedure by an artificial way, or can be temporarily placed on the reaction tube circulating temporary storage unit and sequentially treated by the personnel to be detected. The bottom and the temporary storage slider of reaction tube temporary storage groove correspond and are connected, and the temporary storage slider can slide at the slide rail of keeping in, makes things convenient for the inspection personnel to handle.

Because the boiling water bath takes the most time, the embodiment is provided with three boiling water baths, each boiling water bath is provided with 12 water bath holes (not shown in the drawing), one reaction tube can be placed in each water bath hole, and 36 reaction tubes can be placed in total. 18 oscillating holes are arranged in the oscillator, and a reaction tube can be placed in each oscillating hole. 18 centrifugal grooves are arranged in the centrifuge, and a reaction tube can be arranged in each centrifugal groove. According to the embodiment, the boiling water baths are arranged more, so that the utilization efficiency of the equipment is improved, and the condition that the progress of the whole extraction work is influenced by a certain bottleneck process is avoided. In the embodiment, the gene extraction work can be carried out on two batches of 36 blood samples at one time, the work efficiency is effectively improved, and in practical application, the number of the reaction tubes can be adjusted according to different conditions, so that the utilization rate is maximally improved, and the cost is saved.

In this application, the six-axis robot and the specific working principle, internal structure, connection relation, working process, relevant supporting sensor that control extraction tool removed are known technology, and no longer repeated here.

Although the invention has been shown and described in detail with respect to the preferred embodiments thereof, it will be understood by those skilled in the art that various changes in form and details may be made therein without departing from the spirit and scope of the invention as defined by the appended claims.
